other_risks: automated R&D in other domains (energy, robotics, weapons development)
rapid disruptions to the global balance of power

mentioned.quote: including model capabilities that could enable or enhance attacks on computer systems, networks, or digital infrastructure

threshold.quote: Completely autonomous cyber operations with novel offensive capability development and adaptive persistence.
threshold.note: Cyber Offense Tier 2 (Tier 1 also p.6); p.6 'When a model reaches a particular risk tier, we implement safeguards proportionate to that level of risk.'

response.note: No binding named response. p.6: 'we implement safeguards proportionate to that level of risk. These may include ...' (proportionate, hedged); p.10 additional mitigations deployed where residual risk exceeds acceptable levels, none named; p.12 security mitigations 'as appropriate'. No not-deploy/pause gate: p.10 'Provided the residual risk falls within acceptable levels ... the model is approved' is a sufficient, not necessary, condition.

acc_decider.note: No named decider for tier/response: p.10 justification documented by 'the risk owner' (unnamed role); Anthropic Ireland board only 'oversees implementation' (p.15); Legal and Compliance function handles framework updates only (p.15).

acc_external.note: No binding external review: p.14 'We may solicit input from external actors'; p.14 lighter-touch evaluations 'may include ... collaborating with external experts'; p.5 external red-teaming described as current practice with no condition (E1); p.10 bug bounty under 'we may rely on'.
